quest.title: To Wavey Bay!
quest.description: Mualani told you about the many aquatic attractions on offer at Wavey Bay...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Sunshine, waves, and koholasaurs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaand the minute she sees the water, it's like the rest of us don't exist. Paimon thought "Umo{RUBY#[S]Unity}ja" meant no person left behind...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Quick, this way! C'mon guys, stop lollygagging... Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh! Coming, coming!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Look, tell me what you see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A wooden plank.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not just any old wooden plank. Read what it says!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh, it's a sightseeing map.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Exactly! This map is as precious as a key to a vault of untold treasures...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, I see that! It's like a call to adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes! Or, like a burning ember of phlogiston!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Phlogiston? Oh... That's a type of energy, isn't it? So, is a map like phlogiston because... just a little spark is enough to light a fire under someone?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Exactly! And just like phlogiston, a map is super important!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: With a map to guide your way, you're free to carve out your very own path of adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe, freedom and adventure! I like the sound of that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, hold your horses, folks... Why does Paimon feel like Mualani's hiding something?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright, everyone, time for solo exploration!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what kind of tour guide calls it quits the minute we get to the part where we're supposed to, y'know... TOUR!?

choices.text: Maybe Mualani just wants to go off on her own?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hehe, spoken like a true friend. I won't forget that you had my back!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Here, just take a look. These two major attractions have been marked "Under Testing." My guess is that they've run into some issues.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So, if we split up, we all get to check out the attractions we're interested in, and we can help out with the testing at the same time! Maybe we'll even get Wavey Bay up and running sooner than expected!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you were looking out for the group the whole time... Sorry. Paimon thought you were just obsessing over water activities...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hehe, don't sweat it. Why don't we regroup near that giant koholasaur building when we're done?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Based on the guiding experience I've racked up over the years, my gut tells me the entrance to the main challenge should be somewhere around there!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Alright then, let's split up. Don't forget to keep checking the map!

talks.objective: Check out the attractions your companions are visiting

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Sharp eyes! I didn't expect you to spot me all the way up here.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Looks like you've taken an interest in the facilities here as well.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I think they're pretty good, but "fun" is subjective. What I say's not gonna sway you, you'll have to try it for yourself.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: See that track over there?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Use paintballs to color the balls lined up on the tracks. Once they're all the same color, the balls will disappear with a "bang."

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: By which I mean that someone else might be standing nearby with their own gun. They'll be waiting to send those colored balls flying when the time's right.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Give it a try and see. Just use that gun over there.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I'll watch you play this time. Good luck.

choices.text: I almost want to believe you.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Relax, it's easy. Fitting, given the name of this place. You wouldn't be able to find anything "complicated" or "hard" around here even if you tried.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: How was it?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Haha, so sure of yourself! Nevertheless, I think you did a great job.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Maybe I can give some suggestions to the staff to have them make improvements down the line.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: In any case... They should really let two contestants compete to see who comes out on top.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Haha, staying focused takes a lot of energy.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Was it? Then it looks like we've come to the same conclusion.

talks.objective: Head to the giant koholasaur building to regroup

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Great, let's do a headcount. One, two, three, four...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Huh, that's one more than before...

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! I'm guessing you're here to take on the main challenge at Wavey Bay? Unfortunately, we've run into a bit of a problem...

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: But, um... Here, I can still take a group photo for you if you need one for your album...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No... That's not how it's supposed to go!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Photos are just a way to preserve memories, something to look back on and remember all the happy moments. What matters to us is the actual experience itself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, these particular photos can be exchanged for prizes, but... Yeah, okay, you're right. Just snapping a photo and rushing off wouldn't feel right.

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: I understand, and I'm very sorry about this. Please bear with us a little longer, we'll do our best to resolve the issue as soon as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How long do you think it'll be?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: That's hard to say...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Can we do anything to help?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I noticed you don't have a lot of staff working on the other attractions in Wavey Bay, and the saurian employees seem pretty tired out.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'm guessing it's because the main attraction ran into trouble, so everyone was temporarily reassigned to help with the repair work?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Relax, I get there are probably things you can't disclose. I'm not trying to make things harder for you.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: In fact, I might be able to make your life easier. My companions are all very capable and happy to help out. They just finished testing Twilight Cruise and Asha Speedrun.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If you told us what the issue was, I bet we could help you solve it in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what a tactful negotiator! Guess that's the hidden power of a Peacemaker...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Wait, Chasca... How did you notice all that? You weren't spying on us from up in some treetop somewhere, were you?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Does that really matter right now...?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: What matters... is that we're really good helpers! So, if there's a problem, we're more than happy to do our part to fix it!

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Well, your observations were right, down to the detail about our saurians... I'm sorry, I shouldn't have tried to hide anything from you all.

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: So basically...

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: During testing, we realized that the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide's current paint job still leaves a LOT to be desired. Since it has to be sprayed from the Spiritway, it's a formidable challenge, to say the least.

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: To avoid delaying the resort's official opening, we had to temporarily shut it down. Right now, we're working around the clock to get it completed.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Haha... You call that a challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Tell me where the paint is, and I'll get it done in one go!

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Huh? But... I don't see how you could possibly...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ah, that's because you've never met her before. This is "Umo{RUBY#[S]Unity}ja" Mualani.

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Mualani... Wait a sec, THE Mualani!?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: You mean... one of the six heroes? THAT Mualani!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great job, Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Phew... That, was, AWESOME! How was I, guys? Not bad, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It looks incredible! A truly heroic effort, honestly!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Paimon told me all about you while you were out there. Everything you managed to accomplish is so amazing! Seriously, I feel all fired up just thinking about it!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Aww, thanks, haha! I'm so hyped right now, I feel like I could throw a hot spring party right here!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, look! The staff from Wavey Bay are here too! After all that hard work, they must be looking forward to finally letting their hair down!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I think they've got other ideas, actually...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Mualani, Mualani! Could I get your autograph?

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: Me too, please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like the cat's out of the bag.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uh oh, better take the group photo now, before the crowd gets here!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay, I wanna see big smiles and confident vibes! Think about the ocean, and your lucky colors...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Koholasaur!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Must be about time to go meet up with the others. Now, we just need to find that giant koholasaur building— Oh, there it is!
